messages:
dana m: Hi team  quick one  my last name changed after I got married and I updated it in Workday yesterday, but the pharmacy says my card name doesn't match and they won't fill my maintenance meds. They want an employer letter or updated ID.

harry: Sorry that's blocking you. We can issue an employee name-change verification letter on company letterhead that confirms the member ID and new legal name. Do you have the pharmacy contact and Rx number?

dana m: Rx # 12345678 at Maple Pharmacy (store #42). They said they need either the updated physical card OR a letter with Member ID + DOB + plan group number.

people-ops-bot: Automated note: For plan eligibility/name changes, People Ops requires HR confirmation of legal name change plus ESI/insurer update. Typical turnaround for insurer sync: 1-3 business days. Temporary verification letters can be provided same day.

ana p: @dana m I can generate the verification letter now. Please DM me a photo of the marriage certificate or the Workday confirmation screenshot to attach to the internal ticket. Also confirm whether you need the letter sent to the pharmacy fax or emailed.

dana m: Sent the Workday screenshot in DM. Pharmacy fax is 206-555-0887. Can you also cc my personal email so I can show it on my phone?

benefits-admin: Drafting letter: "Redwood Inference Benefits Office 
Re: Verification of Coverage for Dana Martinez (formerly Dana Miller) 
Member ID: R-11789-2 
DOB: 1989-06-12 
Plan: Redwood Core PPO (Group 879453) 
Effective: 2024-01-01 
This letter verifies the above named member is active and enrolled. Please accept for pharmacy fulfillment."

harry: We faxed it to 206-555-0887 and emailed dana.m@personal.example.com. Ticket #PO-8123 created and linked to HR change request 8342.

dana m: Pharmacy accepted the fax and filled my meds. Thank you! One follow-up  when will the insurer update the card with my new last name?

people-ops-bot: Insurer update ETA: 48-72 business hours after HR confirmation. We will order a replacement physical card once the insurer confirms the name change. If you need a printed temporary card sooner, we can attach the virtual ID PDF to the fax; DM benefits-admin to request that.

harry: FYI, after insurer confirms we trigger a card reprint and mail to your home address. I'll follow up on ticket PO-8123 when carrier confirms. Glad it worked out. :thumbsup:
